research_notes.amha_insights: AMHA is led by T. Sean Adams, a lifelong Ashtabula resident with strong community ties. The organization manages 1,100+ families and has active HUD capital projects. They're a prime candidate for landlord portal integration for Section 8 program. Email pattern is first initial + last name @ashtabulamha.com.
research_notes.city_insights: City of Ashtabula has a consolidated Planning & Community Development department handling housing. They have a dedicated Housing Inspector (Steve Nelson) and require annual rental property registration. Mary Church as Assistant Director would be the key decision-maker for new technology partnerships.
outreach_strategy: 1. Start with Mary Church (mchurch@cityofashtabula.com) for City of Ashtabula - she oversees all PCD functions
2. CC Kimberly Adams (kadams@cityofashtabula.com) for administrative coordination
3. For AMHA, contact T. Sean Adams (sadams@ashtabulamha.com) directly - he's the Executive Director
4. Reference specific pain points: landlord registration automation for City, Section 8 landlord recruitment for AMHA
5. Mention local connection - NAI is focused on Ashtabula County growth
